content.user_title: Enforce Quality Gates Before Complex Work
content.value_statement: Agents waste time when tasks start with unclear requirements or hidden blockers. This skill adds gates for complexity, dependencies, evidence, and escalation before work proceeds.
actual_capabilities: Scores task complexity on a five-level scale using scope, files, time, dependencies, and unknowns.
Checks critical questions, dependencies, attempts, and evidence before implementation starts.
Classifies work as pass, warning, or blocked using clear threshold rules.
Provides templates for gate checks, complexity assessment, and requirements completeness.
Guides escalation when an agent is stuck after repeated failed attempts.
limitations: It does not run tests, builds, scans, or deployment checks by itself.
It relies on accurate task details from the agent, user, or project context.
It cannot resolve missing dependencies or unclear requirements without human input.
The templates may need adaptation for each team workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan a Complex Feature
use_cases.description: Assess scope, identify unknowns, and require a breakdown before starting a large implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Requirements Before Sprint Work
use_cases.description: Check functional behavior, API contracts, validation, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before assigning work.

use_cases.title: Escalate Blocked Automation
use_cases.description: Track failed attempts and produce a clear escalation note when progress needs human guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Check Task Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner gate check for a single task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quality-gates to review this task before implementation. Identify complexity level, unanswered questions, dependencies, and whether work can proceed.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Requirements Completeness
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for unclear product or API work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the requirements checklist for this feature. Report missing functional requirements, error cases, input rules, output expectations, and technical contracts.

prompt_templates.title: Break Down High Complexity Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for Level 4 or Level 5 tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this project with the complexity template. If it is Level 4 or 5, split it into Level 1 to 3 subtasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Failed Agent Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these failed attempts with quality-gates. Determine whether the task is blocked, summarize what was tried, and draft the escalation guidance needed.

output_examples.input: A request to add authentication across several services with unclear roles and no migration plan.
output_examples.output: Gate status: blocked. Complexity is high, role rules are missing, database changes are unclear, and a breakdown plan is required.

output_examples.input: A small UI text change with one file, no dependencies, and clear acceptance criteria.
output_examples.output: Gate status: pass. Complexity is low, requirements are complete, and no blockers were identified.

output_examples.input: An agent has tried three approaches to fix the same build failure without success.
output_examples.output: Gate status: blocked. The skill recommends escalation with attempt history, current blocker, and specific questions for human guidance.

best_practices: Run a gate check before complex or unclear work starts.
Document assumptions whenever a task proceeds with warnings.
Escalate after repeated failed attempts instead of repeating the same approach.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation when critical requirements are unknown.
Treating a Level 4 or Level 5 task as one uninterrupted task.
Marking work complete without passing evidence or clear acceptance criteria.

faq.question: Does this skill execute quality checks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning rules and templates. The agent or user must run actual tests and checks.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before complex tasks, unclear requirements, risky changes, or repeated failed attempts.

faq.question: What does a blocked gate mean?
faq.answer: A blocked gate means work should pause until missing requirements, dependencies, evidence, or plans are resolved.

faq.question: Can it help with small tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can confirm that simple tasks have clear scope and no hidden blockers.

faq.question: Does it replace engineering judgment?
faq.answer: No. It structures judgment and escalation, but humans still decide priorities and acceptable risk.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
